$comment: sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN) on every POSIX format. A sysconf name is an index into the C library's own table and differs per platform (84 for glibc, 58 for the macOS SDK — the references' own headers, measured 2026-10-10); the shipped <unistd.h> declared it for ELF alone, so this program did not compile for Mach-O. Exit 42 = the processor count is plausible (at least 1, below the page size), and asking through a variable gives the same answer as asking with the name. The reference compilers run this file to 42 on each platform. The release arm is the same file through the optimizer.
